Oil shock— Unavailable

Why Unavailable

Model channel: Shock persistence

Rule
Rising needs Brent last-day 12m and 24m horizon roles both up at least 2.00% over one month (exact calendar month when it qualifies; otherwise the nearest viable listed contract within bounds); falling needs both down at least 2.00%; front-loaded or mixed moves stay stable. A missing exact calendar month is not read as a quiet, persistent path.
Not stored for this run

Rule id: brent_12m_24m_1m_persistence
Threshold: Brent 12m and 24m 1m change band ±2.00%
Raw-material pricesMonthly— Unavailable

Why Unavailable

Model channel: Raw-material cost pressure

Rule
Monthly layer. Falling means StatCan raw-materials prices excluding crude energy dropped 0.40% or more month over month. Rising needs +0.40% or more; anything in between is Stable. This is not an import-price index: RMPI includes Canadian raw-material purchases. No import-price series is pinned. The stored channel id remains imported_pressure.
Not stored for this run

No stored direction input for this channel on .

Context — not an input

Crude energy is excluded from this channel; oil moves enter through Shock persistence. RMPI excluding crude energy is a raw-material purchase index, including Canadian-produced materials. It is not an import-price index, and imported cost pressure is not labeled.

Consumer-price breadth— Unavailable

Why Unavailable

Model channel: Consumer price breadth

Rule
Rising needs at least 62.5% of the eight CPI majors positive month over month and CPI-trim 3m annualized acceleration above +0.20pp; falling needs at most 37.5% with acceleration below -0.20pp.

Producer prices ex-energyMonthly— Unavailable

Why Unavailable

Model channel: Production network pressure

Rule
Monthly layer. Rising means IPPI excluding energy rose 0.30% or more month over month; falling means a drop of 0.30% or more; between those bands is stable. The quarterly sector PPI is shadow-only and is not an input.
Not stored for this run

No stored direction input for this channel on .

Context — not an input

This channel is monthly IPPI excluding energy and petroleum products. Headline IPPI and the quarterly Energy sector include the energy shock, so oil can move those readings while this channel does not. Energy is not added to this vote.

Rule
Rising needs Brent last-day 12m and 24m horizon roles both up at least 2.00% over one month (exact calendar month when it qualifies; otherwise the nearest viable listed contract within bounds); falling needs both down at least 2.00%; front-loaded or mixed moves stay stable. A missing exact calendar month is not read as a quiet, persistent path.

  • Services · 2026-Q2 · +1.996% q/q · age 32 days
Methodology, revisions and sources

The quarterly sector layer is shadow-only. It is not in the direction, strength, or net vote, and it does not replace monthly IPPI excluding energy or RMPI excluding crude energy.

Do not add Energy to Non-Energy, Goods, or Services. They are separate analytical aggregates. Goods includes total IPPI, so it is not a non-energy transmission measure and it is not added to the Energy sector.

No pass-through elasticity is estimated. These are separate observed price changes, not a structural Prima decomposition and not a reproduction of the Bank of Canada's model.

Quarterly q/q readings are not classified with the monthly IPPI or RMPI bands. The monthly bands are unchanged, and these quarterly changes are not in the scored vote. Proposed scored change: none.

Each quarterly release can revise the previous two quarters. Weight updates revise the index back to the start of the new weight reference year. This feed stores the latest vintage only, not a real-time history. Observable release vintages in this response: 1. Back history published on the first public release (2026-10-09) was not observable in earlier quarters. A scored change is not proposed: the sample is not a real-time track record, the indexes are quarterly, and no Prima weights or elasticities are published.

Energy. Official StatCan sector Energy. Bank of Canada Staff Analytical Paper 2026-46 groups NAICS 211 oil and gas extraction, 2121 coal mining, and 22 utilities. This is the direct quarterly energy producer-price aggregate.

Non-Energy. Official StatCan sector Non-Energy. SAP 2026-46 defines it as selected agriculture, forestry, fishing, metal-ore mining, and non-metallic mineral mining. It is not IPPI excluding energy and it is not a residual of all non-energy producer prices.

Goods. Official StatCan sector Goods. SAP 2026-46 includes manufacturing, whose price source is total IPPI vector 1230995983 (energy and petroleum products included), plus selected residential and non-residential building construction. It is not a non-energy goods index and must not be added to the Energy sector.

Services. Official StatCan sector Services. SAP 2026-46 covers selected wholesale, retail, rail freight, truck transportation, couriers, and commercial machinery rental and leasing. Coverage is incomplete and the index starts later than the other three sectors. This is an observed sector price, not an estimated pass-through elasticity.
